app.name: Scylla Cluster Tester
app.one_liner: A containerized test automation framework for validating ScyllaDB clusters under high load using orchestrated loader and monitoring nodes.

screens.name: Test Orchestration Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display and control the lifecycle of Scylla cluster tests including provisioning, execution, and monitoring.

rust_commands.name: save_item
rust_commands.purpose: Persist test configuration or results to storage.

mvp_plan: week 1: Configure AWS credentials for test provisioning
week 1: Deploy minimal Scylla cluster with one loader node
week 1: Set up hydra Docker environment
acceptance_tests: System can launch a Scylla cluster and associated loader machine using hydra on AWS.
